user.title: Important Entities Watchdog
user.description: Pick a label and the period after which entities are considered silent.

data_description.period: How long an entity may stay silent (or a connectivity device unreachable) before it is flagged. Minimum 1 minute.
data_description.realtime: Re-evaluate entity freshness on every source state event. Off by default; with this off, the watchdog only checks periodically (every 1/10 of the silent threshold), which is much cheaper for high-frequency sources.

error.period_too_short: The silent threshold must be at least 1 minute.

abort.already_configured: This label and period combination is already configured.
abort.no_labels: No labels found. Create a label in Home Assistant first and assign it to the entities you want to monitor.
